<script>
  (function () {
    const script = document.currentScript;
    const wrapper = script.closest(".card");

    if (!wrapper) return;

    const id = wrapper.dataset.id;
    if (!id) return;

    const halfCircle = document.getElementById(id);
    if (!halfCircle) return;

    let pct = parseFloat(halfCircle.dataset.percentage) || 0;
    pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, pct));

    const trackColor = halfCircle.dataset.trackColor;
    const fillColor = halfCircle.dataset.fillColor;

    const trackPath = halfCircle.querySelector(".semi-circle-track");
    const fillPath = halfCircle.querySelector(".semi-circle-fill");
    const labelContent = halfCircle.querySelector(".card-label");

    if (!fillPath) return;

    // Apply SVG colors
    if (trackPath && trackColor) {
      trackPath.style.stroke = trackColor;
    }

    if (fillColor) {
      fillPath.style.stroke = fillColor;
    }

    if (labelContent && fillColor) {
      labelContent.style.color = fillColor;
      console.log(labelContent, fillColor);
    }

    const length = fillPath.getTotalLength();

    fillPath.style.strokeDasharray = length;
    fillPath.style.strokeDashoffset = length;
    fillPath.style.transition = "stroke-dashoffset 800ms ease";

    fillPath.style.strokeDashoffset = length * (1 - pct / 100);
  })();
</script>
